Keep the bowl-placement check focused on whether a recognizable frog is actually within the bowl, distinguish that from frogs merely on the lid or nearby, and preserve unknown for genuinely unobservable placement. The trace is valid, queried, high-confidence, and has no dependency or transport failure; this is a criterion/routing or aggregation mismatch, not a lack of visual evidence.
